messages:
sara: heads up — staging import run flagged by audit. after importing ~120 users with role_alias mapping, ~8 users briefly had admin in the console for ~25s before reconciliation.

mike: yikes. can you repro locally or in staging replay?

sara: repro in staging with the same payload. steps:
1) POST /admin/bulk_import with payload containing {"role_alias":"platform_admin"}
2) background job maps alias -> role_id and writes to membership table
3) UI caches role grants and shows admin badge before job finalizes

anya: do we have logs showing grant events vs reconciliation? would like tx ids.

sara: logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z import-service INFO import_job=ab12 role_alias=platform_admin mapping_start
2026-03-18T14:02:12Z import-service INFO import_job=ab12 write_membership user=alice role_id=pending
2026-03-18T14:02:35Z sync-worker INFO import_job=ab12 finalize mapping role_id=admin
2026-03-18T14:02:36Z console-cache INFO invalidate user=alice
```

jordan: looks like UI reads from membership table before sync-worker finalizes normalized role. race between API write and normalization. caching TTL too long?

chris: suggest two mitigations: 1) make import write final canonical role_id atomically or use a pending flag that UI hides; 2) make console read fallback to authoritative API on edge cases. hotfix: add guard to UI: hide elevated badges for records with `pending=true`.

anya: also audit side — need KMS audit entries for key ops? any chance keys rotated during import? unlikely but run KMS logs.

auditor-bot: audit-search: found 8 grant events for import_job=ab12 between 2026-03-18T14:02:12Z and 14:02:36Z. No KMS decrypt events correlated.

mike: plan: (a) pause scheduled bulk imports; (b) deploy UI guard for pending flag (short patch); (c) add atomic upsert to import job for canonical role_id; (d) run tenant audit & notify affected customers.

sara: created runbook checklists and opened PR #4722 for UI guard. will run targeted audit and start customer notifications. tagging @legal for notif wording.

anya: also add test to import integration to assert no transient admin view from UI.

jordan: incremental rollout of UI change to 10% then 100%. I'll own rollout and canary metrics.

sara: thanks — will post updates here. :thumbsup:
